note: Node/ending IDs are report locators, not registered commands/save fields. Endings query accumulated real state; they are not prose reward writers. All later numeric fixtures are O prototypes, not accepted balance.

cases.sourceStatus: F0-F3 use unrepaired detached definitions; later stages are campaign-derived original worked proposals. No native delivery/acceptance.

evidence.claim: Held opt-in people, means, choices and fallback.
Held route/stock/report/ordinary lesson and one-order checks.
Actual proposed institutions/people means and private knowledge.

nodes.label: Optional Short Measure meeting
nodes.means: Held proposal: Mira 3 actual logs/10 coins/12 stamina; Wen 4 coins/8 stamina; separate inventories/desks. Player has actual Town access/body/bag.
nodes.knownInformation: Player sees 3 logs and hears 3 outbound +1 reserve promised. Hidden cause/purses are not disclosed.
nodes.time: 12 played-minute response window, opened only by opt-in; unsupported absence frozen.
nodes.aftermath: Actual heard offer; no faction membership or old-save reward.
nodes.consumer: Held begin; E01/E02 opt-in/access still required.

nodes.label: Audit, underwrite, refuse or delay
nodes.means: Physical target stock must be guarded. Underwrite needs 1 owned unencumbered player log.
nodes.cost: Audit: 1 stamina/4 min, paid 2 Mira coins. Underwrite: 1 log+2 stamina/2 min, paid 4. Refuse/defer: no wage/debt.
nodes.time: Commit while offer open; cancellation refunds untouched reservations, no completed audit.
nodes.aftermath: Early route, payer, contribution and specific terms survive every later branch.
nodes.consumer: Held approach/refusal/fallback; E04 stock guard missing.

nodes.label: Independent dispatch and receiving
nodes.means: Audit/refusal/delay: Wen gets 2 logs, Mira retains 1. Underwrite: Wen gets 3, Mira retains 1. Fallback costs Mira 1 coin/1 stamina. Wen receiving costs 1 coin/1 stamina.
nodes.knownInformation: Mira knows her action; Wen sees receipt. Player absent from handover learns nothing yet.
nodes.cost: Each supported route leg pays actual effort. No stock duplication.
nodes.time: Replace held 4/4/1 NPC travel with actual 240/240/40 geography or a separately supported speed; native player travel unchanged.
nodes.aftermath: The nominal Village reserve remains with its actual holder/location; Village cannot spend it while Mira is away.
nodes.consumer: Held delivery/controllers; E02 route repair and native binding missing.

nodes.label: Hear Wen and earn an ordinary procedure
nodes.means: Actual Town arrival, Wen availability, one site slot and player stamina.
nodes.knownInformation: Attributed 2/3-log report; Mira later has a distinct firsthand return report.
nodes.cost: Held tally practice 1 stamina/2 min. Each held check: 1 stamina/2 min for 1 employer coin/order.
nodes.time: Occurrence, player arrival and reveal differ; accepted delivery is not gated by expired initial reply window.
nodes.aftermath: Tally is actually practiced, not obtained from greeting. Early refusal still permits later learning; no retroactive wage.
nodes.consumer: Held report/lesson/finite checks; E04 actual inspected stock and registration still missing.

nodes.label: New finite need and fit-for-use evidence
nodes.means: O readiness fixture: player has obtained 5 actual kits through legitimate paid acquisition, not this scene reward. Campaign Iven proposal: 6 coins/8 stamina/one sampling allowance. The five-kit fixture is only the full worked batch; smaller public terms can use their actual smaller stock and adequately qualified evidence.
nodes.knownInformation: Iven discloses a suspicion; witnessed test or offered report gives only its scoped result.
nodes.cost: O successful trial consumes 1 permissioned player kit; Iven spends 1 coin/1 stamina/3 min. Leaves 4 player kits.
nodes.time: Recheck sample/source/site/participants at irreversible trial. Delay acquires no kits/wages.
nodes.aftermath: Failed paid trial consumes sample without inventing sound goods. Ordinary producer/comparison can qualify an appropriate narrower use.
nodes.consumer: OF.ARC02/03 and E04/E05; S2 inquiry is a bounded candidate, not universal material appraisal.

nodes.label: Agree public/private service terms or decline
nodes.means: Public: Mira has/reserves 4 real coins. Private O fixture: Halden 12 coins/2 appointments, reserves 8 within one 4-unit contract. Player has 4 real kits. Public demand is capped at4 with an explicitly agreed target2/3/4 and a stop rule; escrow matches only that target. It does not require donation or full4 for a small counter.
nodes.knownInformation: Quantity, payer, recipients, withdrawal, exclusivity and permitted disclosure are heard; hidden motives stay private.
nodes.cost: Accept one scoped contract or neither; already committed stock cannot be double-promised.
nodes.time: A new offer has its own announced played window if used, not F0 deadline.
nodes.aftermath: Signatories/rights/public-private-none scope are durable. Late friendliness rewrites no old shipment or promise.
nodes.consumer: SOC02 terms and Bases institutional rights/enforcement binding needed.

nodes.label: Finite handovers up to four, or actual termination
nodes.means: Public: 4 player kits to Mira, 4 Mira coins to player. Private: 4 kits to Halden, 8 buyer coins to player, one appointment used. These are the full4-unit worked totals; a smaller accepted public target transfers/pays only its actual target. Completion is fulfillment of chosen terms, not always4.
nodes.knownInformation: Recipient sees each unit; Wen learns later allocation only through actual delivery/report.
nodes.cost: O per unit: 1 kit+1 player stamina, 2 played min; public pays1/private2 coins. Reserve next unit only; no fifth order.
nodes.time: 8 min/4 stamina for four units plus actual acquisition/travel/recovery. Live scope/contact rechecked at meaningful phases.
nodes.aftermath: Distinct order receipts, units paid, remaining stock and obligations. Termination retains completed units/payments.
nodes.consumer: E05 finite demand/routine, ME04 phases and one native envelope missing.

nodes.label: Mature review: operate, hand off or close
nodes.means: O worked public path without optional earlier checks: Mira has2 coins after underwrite+4 wages,4 after audit+4 wages,5 after own correction+4 wages. Any earlier optional check debits its actual payer balance. Handoff lesson requires1 own coin/1 own stamina,1 player stamina and3min. Then a declared NPC audit uses1 own stamina/2min on one of her4 kits; kits remain4, no audit wage/stock grant. Smaller targets retain their actual unspent stock/funds. Canonical resilient service additionally needs an actual useful process/site/preparation/control output; signed4 units alone cannot fake it.
nodes.knownInformation: Review lists actual fulfilled work/stock/rights, known evidence and current accepted role.
nodes.cost: A successor learns one narrow real operation using its own body/tool/source; no copied player bag/stats or unpaid compulsory helper.
nodes.time: Milestone review, no rewind. Only supported local intervals/paid-job clocks continue; unsupported absence freezes.
nodes.aftermath: Only cumulatively eligible outcomes resolve. Trained resident creates one real matched-order result through an actual audit consumer, not a new kit or cloned learner. Native quiet livelihoods remain valid.
nodes.consumer: OF.ARC05 and E08 actual learner/rights/operation consumer required.

endings.usefulAftermath: Known finite public service and stock-backed ordinary craft/inquiry/travel.
endings.returnHistory: Each speaker retains its own initial2/3-log history; no global favor.
endings.qualification: Small and resilient subvariants follow canonical OF.END.01/.02. A full4-unit batch is this report's numerical fixture, not a universal ending gate; resilience also requires actual useful preparation/process/site/control.

endings.usefulAftermath: Finite paid private demand; Halden holds4 kits/4 remaining coins. Native shops remain usable.
endings.returnHistory: Buyer knows its contract; Mira can be cordial while refusing public-stock loans.
endings.qualification: Maps OF.END.04. This does not substitute for OF.END.03's independent mature specialist feat.

cumulativeRequirements: paid teaching and performed funded operation
endings.usefulAftermath: Resident performs one narrow job with its own means while player explores.
endings.returnHistory: Supported work only; spent stock and earlier contribution remain, no absent years/rewards.

cumulativeRequirements: no new promise or disclosed termination
endings.usefulAftermath: Native gathering/work/training continue; fresh paid restart possible.
endings.returnHistory: Refusal, silence, paid failure and partial termination have distinct reports.
endings.qualification: Early refusal closes only its offer, not a mature-world requirement. Paid failed/terminated charter maps OF.END.05 only with the actual signed/funded attempt; actual paid departure maps OF.END.07. No ending automatically marks a world complete.

invariants: Early refusal does not bar held later learning.
Disclosure, institution rights and body/source are independent.
Reopening uses new terms, not old reward replay.

nodes.label: Original family-school prologue
nodes.means: O Ena:1 unique unborrowed repair tool,6 real logs,6 coins,8 stamina,1 bench right and declared actual packing competence/body. O adult Soren/Hale/Pera:4/2/3 coins and8 stamina each.
nodes.knownInformation: Chosen introduction only: Soren biological child, Hale adopted child, Pera unrelated apprentice. Actual/claimed ancestry and private aims differ.
nodes.time: Career chapters are milestones, not free elapsed years. Childhood mode is optional later origin work.
nodes.aftermath: Known people/terms; surname/spawn timestamp grants no age/source.
nodes.consumer: SOC11 family/known-graph initialization missing; optional for present-era Frontier.

nodes.label: Early care, learning, mediation or refusal
nodes.means: Ena can fund at most2 lessons on one actual occupied bench/tool. Care/repair uses the same occupancy, not a parallel free slot.
nodes.knownInformation: Known offers and independent replies; no private preference tooltip.
nodes.cost: O lesson: Ena1log+1coin+2stamina, learner2stamina,4min; makes1 actual kit held by Ena and a real practiced procedure. Player gift if chosen transfers only its actual scope.
nodes.time: Choose while available. Delay can lose appointment to independently funded lesson; unsupported absence frozen.
nodes.aftermath: Real practiced/kept contribution or refusal is caused state, not skill by blood or affection purchase. Keeping the agreed care appointment can prompt Ena's private archive introduction; refusal still permits a paid Pera inspection, not forfeiture of all learning.
nodes.consumer: Paid source/tool/participant teaching/care consumers still needed.

nodes.label: Disputed archive and disclosure
nodes.means: O allegation of ancestor diverted fund; a dated counter-receipt Pera may disclose. Records create no present estate money.
nodes.knownInformation: Pera knows counter-evidence; Rell initially heard allegation; player learns only inspected/reported evidence.
nodes.cost: O inspection: player1coin to Pera, each1 stamina,3min. Access/disclosure separately agreed; appointment/contact and actual means required.
nodes.time: Past occurrence and present reveal differ; unknown dates stay partial order.
nodes.aftermath: Preserve assertion/authenticity limits/current belief and recipients. No inherited guilt or universal acquittal.
nodes.consumer: SOC01 durable conflicting evidence/disclosure and issuer context missing.

nodes.label: Developed work and independent learner decision
nodes.means: Second lesson at most: Ena1log/1coin/2stamina, learner2stamina/4min. Two lessons leave Ena4logs/4coins/4stamina/2kits.
nodes.knownInformation: Only participants saw method; others need actual report/demo. Soren may leave trade, Hale may steward, Pera may develop learned refinement.
nodes.cost: A replacement or additional trial pays actual inputs; missed lesson is not retroactively completed.
nodes.time: Labels earlier/developed reflect causes, not free decades of mastery; unresolved jobs do not cross an undeclared jump.
nodes.aftermath: Actual competence/willingness/occupied shifts decide later possibility.
nodes.consumer: NPC ability/work procedure and ME04 live participant support required.

nodes.label: Institution response and voluntary retirement terms
nodes.means: Ena grants only actual tool/bench rights; Rell decides declared local recognition, not Ena's property or private relationships.
nodes.knownInformation: Received evidence/skill/terms only; an allegation alone is not author-truth.
nodes.cost: Accept/refuse a specific right/bequest/attribution/role; no automatic heir-debt formula.
nodes.time: Announced milestone after obligations settled; neither death nor automatic family aging.
nodes.aftermath: Known evidence and actual competence/terms qualify outcomes; last nice line erases nothing.
nodes.consumer: SOC02/13, Bases issuer/site permission and recognition missing.

nodes.label: Actual handoff or narrow settlement
nodes.means: One unique tool transfers once, loans resolved; one bench-use right changes without duplicate land/site; method stays with legitimately trained learners and living Ena.
nodes.knownInformation: Each person hears its accepted role; public notice is actual chosen disclosure.
nodes.cost: Ceremony grants no stock/power; remaining teaching/repair pays actual costs.
nodes.time: Recheck holder/body/source/consent/availability at irreversible phases. Old acceptance renews no personal permission.
nodes.aftermath: Property, vocation, method lineage, kinship and private relationship close separately.
nodes.consumer: Engine custody/receipt, rights and taught function adapters required; no schema selected.

nodes.label: Later career chapter and return
nodes.means: Only actual remaining stock/rights/tools and funded plans. Optional adult reciprocal invitation is separate with current eligibility, choice, shared time/meal if selected.
nodes.knownInformation: Speaker-specific known lessons, archive disclosures, role changes and actual recent events.
nodes.cost: New work/meeting costs actual means; romance grants no estate/office/source and gates no ending.
nodes.time: Freeze default. Actual life-stage/year/body projection needs separate Origins/Timelines adapter.
nodes.aftermath: Living retired Ena, independent learners and school differences remain playable.
nodes.consumer: Local observer context/native choices; optional adult/body or chapter-time adapters only where chosen.
